fixed.climate: dream exterior at the wood's edge, under the same hot midsummer afternoon (geography.json LOC-rabbits-house 'as thick-wood')

dream_design.flora: climbing roses and honeysuckle wreath the door and the upstairs window; sweet peas on canes beside the cucumber-frames; the trees behind the house have flowing, curving boughs
dream_design.ornament_cues: the brass plate 'W. RABBIT' sits inside a floral cartouche above the door, and the door has a round fanlight (form and material belong to architecture); the upstairs window is a rounded arch, framed by the climbers, where Alice's arm later bursts out
dream_design.palette: warm cream walls, rose and honeysuckle-cream flowers, sage leaves, polished brass gold, sun-baked honey earth
dream_design.seasonal_guard: roses, honeysuckle and sweet peas flower in July; cucumber-frames in summer use
dream_design.reason: The house, brass plate, window and cucumber-frames are explicit (ch004-p03, p15..p28). Climbers, cartouche and palette are designed to WR-010.

fixed.ground_and_flora: a small yard of dry, sun-baked earth and summer grass; glass cucumber-frames glinting in the sun; trees in full July leaf behind the house
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from the family's own house and housemaid on a summer afternoon. The house stands in the same hot sunshine as the waking bank, so the yard, window and roof are seen as an ordinary sunny July afternoon at home.
